title: Mediterranean Pilaf with Mushrooms
description: A flavorful and nutritious Mediterranean pilaf dish made with sautéed mushrooms, pilaf, and a blend of herbs and spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the uncooked pilaf and stir to combine with the mushroom mixture.
Add the dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
